g.text: Every item of chain block C lands by book height x+9
act(C) = lastb(C) + FIN_GATE_BLOCKS + 1 · here lastb(C) = x
C includes book blocks ≤ x, plus items
TXGATE: x+9 waits for a finalization of x
TXGATE: the sequencer applies no op of block h until it holds a finalization of book block h − 9.
